brief: A cross-platform short video clipper designed for calm, frictionless capture. Primary accent is #ffd700 (Gold) on deep dark surfaces (#09090B), completely subverting clichéd scissors, cutting blades, and film strips.
criteria: Recognisable at 16 px, zero cutting clichés, harmonious pairing with #ffd700 gold accent on dark UI surfaces.

concepts.name: The Focal Frame
concepts.idea: Two calm in/out brackets [ ] embracing the captured moment.
rationale: Directly speaks the video editing language (In-point, Out-point, Clip) without cliché scissors or film sprockets
Centered golden capsule in #ffd700 represents the isolated, captured moment in pure stillness
Perfect 16 px legibility verified across desktop docks, browser tabs, and application headers

recommendation: The Focal Frame translates the core action of video clipping into an iconic, tranquil brand mark that establishes Yonru as a modern, premium, calm productivity tool.
